text: BS Computer Science Suggested Four Year Plan (2021-2022 Catalog), Freshman Year. Freshman first semester: Introduction to CS&SE (CS 1200); Introduction to Engineering & CS (ECS 1100); Calculus I (Math 2413 or 2417); Computer Science I (CS 1337); 6 hours CORE; and Freshman Seminar (UNIV 1010). Freshman second semester: Computer Science II (CS 2336 or 2337); Discrete Mathematics I (CS 2305); Calculus II (Math 2414 or 2419); Mechanics and Heat (Phys 2325); Mechanics and Heat Lab (Phys 2125); and 3 hours CORE. Courses may be taken in any order, as long as prerequisites are met.

text: BS Computer Science Suggested Four Year Plan (2021-2022 Catalog), Senior Year. Senior first semester: Automata Theory (CS 4384); CS Guided Elective (CS 43XX); CS Guided Elective (CS 43XX); Database Systems (CS 4347); and 3 hours Free Elective (see advisor). text: In the BS Computer Science Suggested Four Year Plan (2021-2022 Catalog), a grade of C- or better is needed in Math 2413 or Math 2417 to move forward. A grade of C or better is required for CS 1336, CS 1337, CS 2305, CS 2336, CS 2337 and CS 3305. Math 2312 (C or better) or 80% on ALEKS is listed as the prerequisite for starting Calculus I. The flowchart also shows CS 1336 and CS 1136 alongside CS 1337 and Math 2413/2414 alongside Math 2417/2419 in the freshman year. Courses may be taken in any order, as long as prerequisites are met.
